name: Dates
description: Calendar-date arithmetic for countdowns, deadlines, and age calculations.

operations.name: date.diffDays
operations.description: Whole days from one date to another (negative when "to" is earlier).

inputs.name: from
inputs.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD (a full ISO timestamp also works)

inputs.name: to
inputs.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD (a full ISO timestamp also works)

operations.howto: Countdown pattern: run time.now first and route its iso output to a state key, then bind "from" to that key and "to" to the target date (a date input's value or an item field); chain both operations on the same trigger, time.now first. The output is named "days". For a per-row countdown inside a list, run the operations on a button click and store days in state; bindings inside list templates read item fields directly.

operations.name: date.addDays
operations.description: Shifts a date by a number of days and returns the new date.

inputs.name: date
inputs.description: Base date, YYYY-MM-DD (a full ISO timestamp also works)

operations.howto: Deadline pattern: bind "date" to a date input or time.now's iso state key and "days" to a number input (numeric strings coerce); route the date output to state and show it with formatDate. The output is named "date".
